notes: Augmentation-diverse ensembles (Stickland and Murray, 2020): every member is trained with AugMix at its own severity, cycling through the paper's severity vector s = [1, 2, 3, 4], with the paper's modification (the augmented mix replaces the image with probability p = 0.875, the image is left as is otherwise) and the AugMix operations that do not overlap common corruptions; after the light augmentation of the comparison. Members are independent networks (the paper shares weights through BatchEnsemble; independent members are the stronger and simpler choice at an equal budget of networks). Uniform average of probabilities. Base recipe as in every baseline. Paths are relative to the repository root.
